# FrontEnd Implementation Skill

## When to Execute
Use when creating or refactoring React 19 UI components in `src/features/`, `src/pages/`, or `src/template/`.

## Step-by-Step Execution
1. Verify component props interface using types from `src/types/`.
2. Use PrimeReact (`DataTable`, `InputText`, `Button`) and React-Bootstrap layout (`Row`, `Col`).
3. Wrap form fields in React Hook Form `Controller` components.
4. Export as a named export.
5. Return code only—no conversational preamble or hook explanations.
